editions.editorial: The throne is empty, the Rebellion meter at twenty percent, as fog and rain obscure the realm. Debt collectors swarm the Clockwork Courier, demanding sixty-eight coins in wealth tax. Those catching bounties keep six hundred twenty-five coins, yet…
